note: Real TWSE OpenAPI responses, unmodified, one set per day the recorder ran (each file holds only the latest session). Day 1 was recorded with curl before the recorder existed; later days with `uv run python -m tests.fixtures.twse.record`. The company file is recorded on the first day only, as the job fetches it only while an instrument is missing.
